# BTicino C300X Integration v1.2.4

This maintenance release contains the latest integration fixes after v1.2.2
and keeps the packaged native C300X device agent at `1.2.3`.

## Changes

- Reduces C300X display dashboard traffic by using a revision check before
  sending the full Home Assistant dashboard payload again.
- Improves stale display-event waiter handling in the native device agent.
- Fixes dashboard configuration flow layout and per-entity display options.
- Keeps Media Readiness forwarding and media-user attributes consistent after
  refreshes.
- Cleans up stair-light address handling around the configured P/N address.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows the old Lovelace card behavior.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant so the packaged
  `1.2.3` agent is installed on the C300X.
